newsitem.title: NORWAY: Year-end portfolio adjustments on Oslo Bourse.
newsitem.headline: Year-end portfolio adjustments on Oslo Bourse.

text.p: The Norwegian stock exchange rose with Wall Street on Thursday in healthy trade caused partly by year-end portfolio changes.
The Oslo Total index closed 0.74 percent higher at 930.02 points in trade worth 911 million crowns.
"It's last-minute portfolio adjustments before New Years," one broker said, explaining the volume. "But Wall Street is decisive."

The bourse opened strongly after Wall Street's upbeat overnight gains, slowed down during the day and then picked up again as the United States followed through on Wednesday's strength and moved higher at the opening.
Oslo's gains were led by industrial conglomerate Norsk Hydro, which climbed 0.62 percent to 325 crowns in 126 million crowns worth of trade. Norsk Hydro has a 20 percent weighting on the index.
Other winners were forestry group Norske Skog A shares which rose four percent to 208 crowns.
